description: Graph isomorphism depends on structure rather than concrete node names and changes as nodes or edges are added.

input.graph_pair: incrementally add equal and unequal node or edge structure

cases.expected_output:
scenario=incremental
empty=yes
one_node_each=yes
two_nodes_each=yes
extra_node_left=no
three_nodes_each=yes
edge_left_only=no
matching_edges=yes

input.graph_pair: same directed shape with renamed nodes and mirrored construction order

cases.expected_output:
scenario=renamed_shape
one_edge=yes
two_edges=yes
three_cycle=yes
after_two_isolated_nodes=yes
after_renamed_tail=yes
